claims.statement: Most requests repeat solved patterns, so running a giant neural network every time wastes memory and energy.
This cascade checks tiny truth tables first and streams specialist model slices from storage only when needed.
Once an automated test certifies a new answer, it compiles downward into a reusable millisecond skill.
Headline outcome: 970 MB Active RAM · 91.7% Verified · 0% Broken (Built-in Apple chip counters and simulated circuit estimates; no board shunt.)

easy_read.easy_title: Turn Checked Answers Into Fast Skills
three_points_one_idea_sentences: This study is about turn checked answers into fast skills.
Most requests repeat solved patterns, so running a giant neural network every time wastes memory and energy.
This cascade checks tiny truth tables first and streams specialist model slices from storage only when needed.
Once an automated test certifies a new answer, it compiles downward into a reusable millisecond skill.
Key result: 970 MB Active RAM · 91.7% Verified · 0% Broken.
Built-in computer chip counters recorded the energy used.
